<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Play dominoes with the movie boxes
We should focus on reality, not movies
Gonta thought he was only one...
Gonta happy to know Shuichi get sleepy, too.

P-Please, no! Movies not toys!
They for watching!

Is rude to the movie-makers!
Ungentlemanly, too!

Bug movies fun, but seeing and touching
bugs best!

We get outta here, Gonta show Shuichi
amazing bugs!

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
